title: Gluing perfectness across two quotient ideals
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: After removing a square-zero quotient the proof realizes the object in a fibre-product exact sequence of K-flat complexes. It proves compactness through derived Hom comparisons over the three quotients and a five-lemma argument, recovering perfectness over the product ideal.
